answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind agent identities to sequential delay functions, forcing Sybil attackers to solve computationally intractable proof trees. To achieve unforgeability, VRF sortition derives non-malleable entropy from physical inputs like thermal emissions of an ember, hydrodynamic flow of a river, and violet spectrum decay. This framework guarantees Byzantine fault tolerance with deterministic finality across all state transitions.
